title_en: Flutter Production Readiness: A Practical Engineering Checklist
title_id: Persiapan Aplikasi Flutter untuk Production: Checklist Engineering
description_en: A practical review of architecture, failures, environments, testing, performance, crash reporting, and release operations for Flutter applications.
description_id: Panduan praktis meninjau arsitektur, penanganan kegagalan, environment, pengujian, performa, crash reporting, dan proses rilis aplikasi Flutter.
summary_en: A release checklist that connects application structure and failure handling with tests, measurement, and post-release maintenance.
summary_id: Checklist rilis yang menghubungkan struktur aplikasi dan penanganan kegagalan dengan pengujian, pengukuran, dan pemeliharaan setelah rilis.
technical_review: Primary Flutter references checked 2026-11-27; examples are conceptual and no project-specific implementation is asserted.

title_en: Designing Reliable Push Notifications in Flutter with Firebase Cloud Messaging
title_id: Merancang Push Notification yang Andal pada Flutter dengan Firebase Cloud Messaging
description_en: A platform-aware guide to FCM message handling, permissions, app lifecycle states, token changes, notification taps, and testing in Flutter.
description_id: Panduan FCM lintas platform tentang penanganan pesan, izin, status aplikasi, perubahan token, interaksi notifikasi, dan pengujian di Flutter.
summary_en: Separate delivery, display, background processing, and tap navigation; each follows different platform and application-state rules.
summary_id: Pisahkan pengiriman, tampilan, pemrosesan latar belakang, dan navigasi saat notifikasi diketuk; tiap tahap mengikuti aturan platform dan status aplikasi yang berbeda.

sources.label: Get started with FCM in Flutter

technical_review: Firebase primary documentation checked 2026-11-27; delivery is not guaranteed and operating-system limits are stated.

title_en: Managing Offline Data and Application State in Flutter
title_id: Mengelola Data Offline dan Application State pada Flutter
description_en: A practical model for local and remote state, persistence, cache freshness, synchronization, conflicts, authentication, and offline testing in Flutter.
description_id: Model praktis untuk state lokal dan remote, penyimpanan, kesegaran cache, sinkronisasi, konflik, autentikasi, dan pengujian offline di Flutter.
summary_en: Treat local data and server data as separate sources with explicit freshness, synchronization, conflict, and authentication rules.
summary_id: Kelola data lokal dan server sebagai sumber terpisah dengan aturan yang jelas untuk kesegaran, sinkronisasi, konflik, dan autentikasi.
technical_review: Primary Flutter architecture and persistence references checked 2026-11-27; recommendations are separated from portfolio-specific claims.
